Host commands: pocket serve <project> [--port 7878], pocket mcp <project>; also pocket run|check|replay|hashes.
Methods (pocket call <method> '<json>'; pocket help <method>):
  assets.list        The project's files with their kind and size (served at /assets/<path>).
  capture            A rendered image or the id buffer's summary of a camera view.
  catalog.list       Every command: name, kind, doc, aliases and the JSON Schema of its parameters.
  debug.state        The debugger: debug.breakpoints.set, debug.breakpoints.clear, debug.pause, debug.continue, debug.step, debug.state, debug.eval, debug.watch, debug.rewind.
  docs.search        Searches command and component names and docs.
  events.since       Game events after a stream number (the newest without one), filtered by name.
  events.why         An event and the chain of events that caused it.
  history.list       The undo and redo stacks' labels, most recent last.
  history.redo       Redoes the last undone edit.
  history.undo       Undoes the last world edit (from the editor or an agent).
  log.since          Script console lines, failed system runs and host messages.
  play.start         Play: forks the edit world and runs the fork in real time; edits go to the fork.
  play.stop          Stop: discards Play's fork and returns to the edit world as it was.
  project.info       The project: name, root, tick rate, scene, scripts and assets.
  project.save       Writes the edit world to the project's scene.json (Play's world is never saved).
  scripts.apply      Compiles the project's scripts (or the given files) and hot-swaps them at a boundary.
  scripts.check      Type checks (when tsc is installed) and compiles the scripts without swapping.
  scripts.list       The project's script files with their sizes and last diagnostics.
  scripts.read       A script file's text.
  scripts.status     The current bundle hash and the systems that ran last tick.
  scripts.write      Writes a script file and compiles the scripts with it (no swap); returns diagnostics.
  snapshot           The world's snapshot (in process; its tick and hash over the wire).
  snapshots.list     The kept snapshots of the world shown (one every 60 ticks, the last 120).
  snapshots.restore  Restores the kept snapshot at or before a tick; clears the history.
  status             Tick, time, pacing, Play or edit, world hash, entity count, bundle.
  subscribe          WebSocket only: the topics pushed to this socket (status is always on).
  time.control       Pause, resume, set the real-time speed or the pacing.
  time.step          Runs ticks; with until/watch, stops early when an event is emitted or a field meets a test.
  world.edit         Spawn, set (fields merge), remove and destroy, all or nothing at one boundary; undoable.
  world.get          An entity's components as JSON (all, or those named).
  world.query        Rows of the entities that have every listed component, with the fields asked for.
  world.schema       Component JSON Schemas with their docs (all, or one).
  world.tree         Entities with their names and component names; filter by name or components.
  world_edit         world.edit's canonical recorded form (edits tagged by op; revive restores a destroyed id).
